scope_limits: No full suite, real live LM or biological graph smoke, training or scientific promotion run in this increment.
Native model HTTP is a bounded deterministic local server with English objectives, actual subprocess workers and registered pytest verification.
One controlled browser response tests completed/current=false display; actual evidence-loss races are separate native tests.
Not every fixture is terminal or reserve-free; heartbeat fixture intentionally leaves a metadata assignment.
Existing last_event keeps historical payload compatibility; new last_action data is sanitized, not a general legacy payload redaction.
Only references/hashes and currentness are added; safe result artifact drilldown and public owner approval/replan adapters remain open.
Final package excludes all uncommitted parallel brain/schema changes; combined routes prove limited interoperability only.
Counts overlap between deltas and package rounds and must not be summed.
